# Engineering Gates

Use for every project task. Follow: discovery → requirements → architecture → risk/prediction → human design approval → contracts → scaffold → slice plan → one approved implementation slice → independent review → phase approval. Check `docs/engineering/PHASE-STATUS.md`. Never infer approval. Stop when prerequisites are absent.
